title: Flat tire removal and compact-spare installation

requirements.display_name: Hard, level and stable work surface

actions.title: Secure the vehicle before lifting
actions.instruction: Park on a hard, flat surface, apply the parking brake, select P, switch the engine off, turn on the hazard flashers, and keep occupants out of the vehicle.
actions.warning_text: Do not lift the vehicle on a soft, sloped, or unstable surface.

actions.title: Chock the wheel diagonally opposite the flat tire
actions.instruction: Place a wheel chock at the appropriate side of the tire diagonally opposite the flat tire so the vehicle cannot roll.

actions.title: Remove the spare tire, jack and wheel-nut wrench
actions.instruction: Retrieve the compact spare, jack and wheel-nut wrench from the trunk and place them where they can be reached safely.

actions.title: Loosen the wheel nuts one turn
actions.instruction: Before lifting the vehicle, loosen each wheel nut approximately one turn without removing the nuts.

actions.title: Position the jack and lift the vehicle
actions.instruction: Place the jack at the rocker-panel jack point nearest the flat tire, confirm the jack is engaged correctly, and raise the vehicle only high enough to remove and install the tire.
actions.warning_text: Use only the designated jack point and never place any part of your body under a vehicle supported only by the supplied jack.

actions.title: Remove the flat wheel
actions.instruction: Remove the wheel nuts and flat wheel. Keep the wheel nuts together where they will not be lost.

actions.title: Install the compact spare and hand-tighten the nuts
actions.instruction: Clean obvious dirt from the wheel-to-hub contact surfaces, install the compact spare, and thread each wheel nut by hand with the tapered side toward the wheel.

actions.title: Lower the vehicle and tighten the wheel nuts
actions.instruction: Lower the vehicle, then tighten the wheel nuts securely in the sequence shown by Toyota. Final wheel-nut torque is 76 lbf·ft (103 N·m).

actions.title: Stow the flat tire and verify the temporary spare
actions.instruction: Secure the flat tire, jack and tools. Confirm the compact-spare pressure and observe Toyota's temporary-spare speed and usage restrictions.
actions.warning_text: A compact spare is for temporary use only; replace or repair the normal tire as soon as possible.
